descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you an analytical thinker and interested in country and political risks? Are you familiar with macro-economic concepts and enjoy working with data and developing new solutions with AI/LLMs? For our Country Risk Internship / Economics, Data & AI Program we are looking for someone who can help us to:

• support the team in managing country risk data and processes for rating and model reviews
• contribute to innovation projects through AI/LLM adoption and data/process automation/visualization
• proactively engage with team members to support deliverables in the areas of country and sectoral risk
